nodes.label: Hard rule: never global $wpdb in plugin code
nodes.rationale: DB access must go through app/Models/ (OptimizationLog, UrlLookup). The two deliberate exceptions, DatabaseRewriter and DataBackfills, need serialization-safe multi-table SQL that cannot go through a model.

nodes.label: Hard rule: never delete by glob over a shared directory
nodes.rationale: Delete only paths you created, resolved from your own records. A glob cleanup already destroyed 54 real user backups.

nodes.label: Hard rule: never weaken a guard to make a test pass
nodes.rationale: Applies to is_serialized(), the __PHP_Incomplete_Class check, and the path-traversal check in BackupManager. If a guard blocks a test, the test is wrong, not the guard.

nodes.label: Hard rule: @wordpress/components is banned
nodes.rationale: The runtime (React, HTTP, i18n) comes from WordPress via @wordpress/element, @wordpress/api-fetch, @wordpress/i18n, externalized by wp-scripts. The UI does not: every control is the plugin's own, using sio-* classes, never core's notice/button/.description markup. build/admin.asset.php must list wp-element and wp-api-fetch but never wp-components.

nodes.label: Hard rule: never add a Composer runtime dependency
nodes.rationale: The plugin ships dependency-free by design; vendor/ holds only the generated autoloader. npm packages are build-time only and must still be named in the spec.

nodes.label: WPCS lives outside the plugin
nodes.rationale: npm run lint:php is used instead of require-dev'ing phpcs, because the committed vendor/ must stay autoloader-only (invariant 12). See context/specs/done/09-phpcs-compliance.md.

nodes.label: Hard rule: every input handler needs capability check, nonce, sanitize on input, escape on output
nodes.rationale: This is the plugin's real attack surface: REST routes, upload MIME handling, generated WebP paths, the cwebp shell-out, backup/restore file paths, unserialize in Services/Rewrite/.

nodes.label: Hard rule: never hand-edit build/**
nodes.rationale: build/** is wp-scripts output; edit resources/** and run npm run build instead.

nodes.label: Hard rule: never touch wp-content/uploads/swift-image-optimizer/backup/
nodes.rationale: That directory is user data, often the only copy of the original image.

nodes.label: FluentCart-style layout (app/ + framework/ roots)
nodes.rationale: No src/, Providers/, Repositories/, Foundation/ inside app/, and no Http/Admin/. The kernel lives at its own framework/ root outside app/, mirroring how FluentCart keeps FluentCart\Framework\* outside app/.

nodes.label: Core premise: this plugin rewrites and deletes user media, backup is often the only copy
nodes.rationale: A bug here does not produce a broken page, it produces a media library the user cannot get back. This drives every hard rule in the file.
